EducationLearner.title: EducationLearner
EducationLearner.description: The Education use case's own learner directory: the one place a National ID is mapped to a Learner ID. Held so that each institution can resolve an authenticated learner without any institution owning the mapping, and so no cross-domain person table is needed — DESIGN forbids one. This entity belongs to Education alone: it must not read or extend AgeCitizen, FarmerRecord or LandRecord. Synthetic data only; see scripts/seed-education.sh.

learnerId.title: Learner ID
learnerId.description: The Education correlation identifier, e.g. EDU-L-004512. This is the value both verifiers correlate across the three credentials. A different namespace and sequence from nationalId and from every institution's student id, because PRODUCT forbids treating any of them as interchangeable.

nationalId.title: National ID
nationalId.description: Issuer-side lookup only, e.g. NAT-70011234. Matched against the authenticated Keycloak account's nationalId claim to decide whose credential may be issued. NEVER issued as a credential claim and never disclosed to either verifier (REQUIREMENTS §2, §7).
